blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Generative artificial intelligence is entering the home. Cloud-based assistants face governance limitations in data transmission, continuous availability, and the reliability of physical actions, which are especially salient in households where devices remain online, data accumulate over time, and commands trigger real-world actions. Using the home local server as a unifying organizing axis, this article develops a design-oriented review framework. Sources from arXiv, CNKI, ACL Anthology, and official documentation were searched through November 2026 and coded into five evidence categories: reviews, system prototypes, benchmarks, HCI and eldercare studies, and official documentation. System designs were mapped onto shared architectural modules, identifying nine recurrent responsibilities of the home local server. Generative models support perceptual interpretation, intent understanding, and candidate planning, while deterministic validation, knowledge-graph constraints, and authorization leases confine candidate actions to an inspectable space. Home control, emotional companionship, and intelligent guarding can be compared within a common framework: they share state and memory but differ in latency, false positive and negative rates, proactivity, and permissions. Existing benchmarks rely on virtual environments and cannot substitute for real-deployment evaluation. Local deployment is not inherently safer, and technical continuity alone does not establish the social or medical effects of companionship and guarding. The article proposes a five-dimensional evaluation framework covering architectural capability, system resources, privacy, safety and reliability, and human experience, together with six design principles and a future research agenda for local-first intelligent home systems.
blocks.zh: 基因人工智能正进入家中. 以云为基础的助手在数据传输,持续可用,以及物理动作的可靠性方面面临治理限制,在设备仍然在线,数据随时间而积累,命令触发现实世界行动的家庭中尤为突出. 本条以家用本地服务器为统一组织轴线,制定以设计为导向的审查框架. 从arXiv, CNKI, ACL Anthology, 和官方文件的来源被搜索到2026年11月,并被编码为五个证据类别:审查,系统原型,基准,HCI和老年人护理研究,以及官方文件. 系统设计被映射到共享的建筑模块上,确定了本地服务器的9个经常性责任。 基因模型支持概念解释、意向理解和候选人规划,而确定性验证、知识图约束和授权租赁则将候选人行动局限于可检查的空间。 家庭控制,情感伴侣关系,以及智能守护等,可以在一个共同框架内进行比较:它们共享状态和记忆,但在耐久性,假正负率,活性,和权限方面却有所不同. 现有基准依靠虚拟环境,不能取代实际部署评价。 当地部署本身并不更加安全,仅靠技术连续性并不能确定陪伴和看守的社会或医疗影响。 文章提出了涵盖建筑能力,系统资源,隐私,安全和可靠性,以及人类经验的五维评价框架,同时提出了六条设计原则和本地第一智能家庭系统的未来研究议程.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction: From Cloud-Based Smart Assistants to the Home Local Server
blocks.zh: 1 导言:从基于云的智能助理到家用本地服务器

blocks.en: Voice-driven smart assistants have become widespread in the consumer market, and the home is among the highest-frequency usage scenarios. Mainstream implementations upload speech and context to the cloud, where remote large models perform understanding and generation, and the results are returned to the terminal. This paradigm has low engineering cost for single-turn question answering, and model updates are rapid. The home scenario, however, differs from general information queries: devices remain online continuously, data accumulate over extended periods, commands can trigger real-world physical actions, and multiple members share the same dwelling. The problem therefore extends beyond one-time data transmission. Platforms can accumulate long-term behavioral profiles of users; once the network is interrupted, basic control fails; and after model updates, devices may exhibit behavioral changes that users did not anticipate.
blocks.zh: 语音驱动的智能助手在消费市场已经普及,家庭是使用频率最高的情景之一. 主流实施将语音和上下文上传到云端,其中远程大型模型能进行理解和生成,结果返回终端. 这种范式对单回合问题回答的工程成本较低,模型更新也很快. 然而,家庭情景与一般信息查询不同:设备持续在线,数据长时间积累,指令可以触发现实世界的物理动作,多个成员共享同一住所. 因此,问题不仅限于一次性数据传输。 平台可以累积用户的长期行为剖面;一旦网络中断,基本控制失败;在模型更新后,设备可能显示用户没有预料到的行为变化.

blocks.en: Progress in edge models and home computing makes an alternative organizational approach feasible. Quantization and distillation enable language models at the billion-parameter scale to run on home gateways, small servers, or development boards, undertaking intent understanding, candidate planning, and dialogue generation. The home local server simultaneously hosts the device registry, state storage, rule engines, and audit logs, converging functions that were previously dispersed across the cloud and multiple vendor applications into a computational node within the dwelling. Here, local-first does not mean absolute disconnection from the network. The criterion adopted in this paper is “local processing by default, with auditable cloud fallback under user authorization,” which is explicitly distinct from the local-only mode of cutting all network connections.
blocks.zh: 边缘模型和家庭计算方面的进展使另一种组织办法成为可行。 量化和提炼使10亿参数范围内的语言模型能够在主网关、小型服务器或开发板上运行,承担意向理解、候选人规划和对话生成。 家用本地服务器同时托管设备注册、状态存储、规则引擎和审计日志,这些功能以前分散在云层中,多个供应商应用成为住所内的计算节点。 在这里,本地第一并不意味着绝对脱离网络. 本文件采用的标准是“默认的本地处理,可审计云在用户授权下回落”,这显然不同于所有网络连接的本地专用模式。

blocks.en: The three task categories of control, companionship, and guarding are currently advanced in separate research communities. The control direction focuses on instruction understanding and device execution; the companionship direction focuses on persona and long-term memory; the guarding direction focuses on event recognition and risk escalation. The underlying problems they share are in fact the same: how to represent state, how to maintain memory, how to orchestrate models, and how to constrain actions. These problems have rarely been discussed under a unified architectural perspective, giving rise to concrete epistemic consequences. State representations or authorization mechanisms accumulated in one community cannot be borrowed by the other two; similar risks are repeatedly named in different applications without a common design vocabulary. Within the search scope and cutoff date set by this paper, no design-oriented review has been identified that uses the home local server as a unifying organizational axis while simultaneously integrating the three task categories. This judgment does not mean that no prior research exists in this direction; rather, it notes that existing surveys are bounded by edge-model technology or a single application category, lacking integration oriented toward home service architecture.
blocks.zh: 控制、陪护和守卫这三个任务类别目前已在不同的研究界得到推进。 控制方向侧重于指令理解和装置执行;伴行方向侧重于人物a和长期记忆;守护方向侧重于事件识别和风险升级. 他们分享的根本问题实际上是一样的:如何代表国家,如何保持记忆,如何协调模型,以及如何约束行动. 这些问题很少在统一的建筑学视角下讨论,从而产生具体的认知后果. 一个社区积累的国家代表或授权机制不能被另外两个社区借用;类似的风险在不同的应用中反复被命名,而没有共同的设计词汇. 在本文件确定的搜索范围和截止日期内,没有确定以设计为导向的审查,在将三个任务类别合并的同时,将本国本地服务器作为统一组织轴线。 这一判断并不意味着以前没有这方面的研究;相反,它指出,现有的调查以边缘模型技术或单一的应用类别为界限,缺乏面向家庭服务架构的综合。

blocks.en: To address this gap, this paper undertakes three tasks. First, it establishes a unified architectural vocabulary, grouping the responsibilities of the home local server into nine modules. Second, it compares the module division and evidence of different systems, clarifying what the local node holds, what the cloud retains, and what constrains execution. Third, it derives a five-dimensional evaluation framework from the gaps left by existing benchmarks, and presents design principles and a research agenda.
blocks.zh: 为了弥补这一差距,本文件承担三项任务。 首先,它建立了一个统一的建筑词汇,将家用本地服务器的责任分组为九个模块. 其次,它比较了模块的划分和不同系统的证据,澄清了本地节点持有什么,云保留什么,以及限制执行什么. 第三,它从现有基准留下的差距中获得一个五维评价框架,并提出设计原则和研究议程。

blocks.en: 2 Conceptual Delimitation and Review Methodology
blocks.zh: 2 概念划界和审查方法

blocks.en: 2.1 Core Concepts
blocks.zh: 2.1 核心概念

blocks.en: The whole-home intelligent service architecture referred to in this paper denotes the overall design that uses a computational node within the dwelling as a hub, organizing device connectivity, perception, state, memory, models, and execution into a continuously running system. The home local server is an umbrella term for forms including network-attached storage, home gateways, small x86 hosts, and edge devices; this paper focuses on its responsibilities and does not discuss specific hardware selection.
blocks.zh: 本文中提到的全家智能服务架构,是指将住宅内的计算节点作为枢纽的整体设计,组织设备的连接,感知,状态,内存,模型,以及执行进入一个连续运行的系统. 家用本地服务器是包括网络附着存储,家用网关,小型x86主机,以及边缘设备在内的窗体的伞名词;本文侧重于其责任,不讨论具体的硬件选择.

blocks.en: Four sets of distinctions affect subsequent judgments. The first is local-first versus fully offline. Local-first means that data and computation are completed within the dwelling by default, and cloud invocations require user authorization and leave traces; fully offline severs all network connections. The two must not be conflated. The second is home state versus home memory. Home state is a structured record of the device registry, room topology, current device states, and user preferences; home memory addresses longitudinal experiences, including dialogue history, user profiles, and long-term events, whose organizational scheme is elaborated in Section 4. The third is model versus Agent. Models provide reasoning capability; the home Agent, on top of the model, undertakes task decomposition, tool invocation, and result integration, serving as an execution unit. The fourth is generative planning versus deterministic execution. Generative models, with language generation at their core, assume responsibilities for perceptual interpretation, intent understanding, planning, and interaction; deterministic executors do not depend on generative output, relying on rules or type constraints to ensure that actions fall within the legal space. Edge models, as the carriers of the above roles, refer to models running on home or terminal hardware, including quantized and distilled small language models and embedded multimodal models.
blocks.zh: 有四套区分影响到以后的判决。 首先是本地第一对全线下线. 本地第一是指在住宅内默认完成数据和计算,云引用需要用户授权并留下痕迹;全线断开所有网络连接. 二者不可混杂. 二是故乡国与故乡记忆. 家用状态是设备注册,房间地形,当前设备状态,用户偏好的结构化记录;家用内存处理纵向体验,包括对话历史,用户简介,以及长期事件,其组织方案在第4节中阐述. 第三个是模特儿和特工 模型提供推理能力;家庭代理人在模型之上承担任务分解,工具引用,以及结果集成,作为执行单位. 第四是基因规划与决定性处决。 以语言生成为核心的基因模型,承担感知解释,意向理解,规划,互动的责任;确定性执行者不依赖于基因输出,依靠规则或类型约束来确保行动属于法律空间. 边缘模型作为上述角色的载体,是指运行在家用或终端硬件上的模型,包括量化和蒸馏的小语言模型和嵌入式多式联运模型.

blocks.en: The meaning of the term “generative” in the title must also be understood within these four sets of distinctions. Generative models assume responsibilities for interpretation and planning; yet non-generative modules—device connectivity, rule engines, deterministic verification, and auditing—are equally necessary components for the safe operation of the system. Prior studies have repeatedly shown that unconstrained open-ended generation produces invalid and even dangerous actions in physical control scenarios. The architectural stance of this paper is therefore the collaboration of these two classes of modules, rather than the replacement of all traditional components by generative models.
blocks.zh: 标题中的“基因”一词的含义也必须在这四套区分中加以理解。 基因模型承担着解释和规划的责任;但非基因模块——设备连接、规则引擎、确定性核查和审计——也是系统安全运行所必需的组成部分。 以前的研究一再表明,不受约束的无限制一代在物理控制情况下会产生无效甚至危险的动作. 因此,本文的建筑定位是这两类模块的合作,而不是用基因模型取代所有传统组件.

blocks.en: 2.2 Review Methodology
blocks.zh: 2.2 审查方法

blocks.en: The sources of this review comprise arXiv preprints, Chinese-language journals and dissertations indexed by CNKI, formally published entries in the ACL Anthology, peer-reviewed journal and conference papers, and official documentation of platforms such as Home Assistant. The search was cut off on 2026-11-08, and the arXiv literature mainly covers the years 2023 to 2026. Search terms were combined along three dimensions—“home/smart home”, “local/edge/on-device”, and “language model/Agent”—with the two thematic term groups “memory” and “security and privacy” added separately; supplementation was then performed by snowballing through the references of the included literature.
blocks.zh: 本次审查的来源包括ARXIV预印本,CNKI索引的中文期刊和论文,ACL人类学正式发表的条目,同行评审的期刊和会议论文,家庭助理等平台的正式文件. 搜索于2026-11-08被切断,arXiv文献主要涵盖2023年至2026年. 搜索词按三个方面合并,即 " 家/智能家 " 、 " 地方/网格/在线 " 和 " 语言模式/代理人 " ,并分别增加 " 记忆 " 和 " 安全和隐私 " 这两个主题词;然后通过参考包括的文献进行雪球补充。

blocks.en: Inclusion followed three principles: direct relevance to the home scenario or to the responsibilities of the home local server; a verifiable formal source; and metadata confirmable from the publisher’s page or the first page of the PDF. Retracted entries were excluded; platform documentation states only functionality and release dates and is not conflated with peer-reviewed evidence. Owing to the limitations of the existing search records, this paper does not report complete screening and exclusion counts for each stage, nor does it claim to have exhaustively covered the related research.
blocks.zh: 纳入遵循三项原则:直接与主机场景或主机本地服务器的责任相关;可核实的正式来源;以及可从出版商网页或PDF第一页确认的元数据。 已删除的条目不包括在内;平台文档仅说明功能和发布日期,不与同行评审的证据相混。 由于现有搜索记录的局限性,本文件没有报告每个阶段的完整筛选和排除计数,也没有声称详尽地涵盖了相关研究。

blocks.en: Evidence is differentiated across five levels. Review articles delimit the technical background and taxonomy; system prototypes carry architectural design and implementation details; benchmark datasets provide comparable evaluation results; human–computer interaction and eldercare research supply usage scenarios and user evidence; official platform documentation is used solely to state platform functionality and release dates. The core references are additionally subjected to structured field coding, with fields covering deployment location, generative role, non-generative modules, state, memory, orchestration, safety, cloud-edge collaboration, evaluation, and inter-module relations. Each system design is subsequently mapped onto a unified set of architectural modules, so as to compare how different systems divide the work of deployment, memory, orchestration, and safety.
blocks.zh: 证据分为五个层面。 审查文章划定了技术背景和分类学;系统原型带有建筑设计和实施细节;基准数据集提供了可比较的评价结果;人机交互和长者护理研究供应使用方案和用户证据;官方平台文件仅用于说明平台功能和发布日期. 核心参考文献还附加了结构化的字段编码,字段涵盖部署位置,基因作用,非基因模块,状态,内存,管弦,安全,云端协作,评价,模块间关系. 每个系统设计随后被映射到一套统一的建筑模块上,以便比较不同的系统如何划分部署、内存、管弦乐和安全的工作。

blocks.en: The delimitation of the technical background rests mainly on review articles. A survey of edge large language models organizes the technical essentials of on-device deployment across three layers—model design, execution methods, and applications [1]. A survey of edge generative AI further consolidates the paths and constraints of migrating generative capabilities to edge devices [2]. A survey of smart spaces examines, as a whole, the methods for creating systems in indoor environments, which helps to delineate the relationship between the home scenario and smart spaces in a broader sense [3]. Chinese-language surveys provide a domestic scholarly lineage. A survey of on-device AI algorithms reviews the application status of edge models in vision, language processing, and the Internet of Things [4]; research progress on large models for edge intelligence summarizes technical challenges along the two threads of edge training and edge inference, and identifies high cost, limited scalability, and information security risks as the principal problems confronting the traditional cloud-based paradigm [5].
blocks.zh: 技术背景的界定主要取决于审查条款。 对边缘大语言模型的调查,组织在三个层面(模型设计、执行方法和应用程序)部署设备的技术要点[1]。 对边缘基因AI的调查进一步巩固了向边缘设备迁移基因能力的路径和制约因素[2]. 对智能空间的调查从整体上审视了在室内环境中创建系统的方法,这有助于从广义上划分家庭情景和智能空间之间的关系[3]. 汉语调查提供了国内学术血统. 对端面AI算法的调查审查了边缘模型在视觉,语言处理和Tthings互联网中的应用状况[4];关于边缘智能大模型的研究进展总结了边缘培训和边缘推论两条线上的技术挑战,并确定高成本,有限可伸缩性和信息安全风险是传统云基范式面临的主要问题[5].

blocks.en: 3 Architectural Foundations of the Home Local Server
blocks.zh: 3 家庭地方服务器建筑基金会

blocks.en: 3.1 Partition into Nine Modules
blocks.zh: 3.1 分成九个单元

blocks.en:
A cross-system comparison yields, first, one observation: the home local server repeatedly assumes an identical set of responsibilities; different systems merely name and combine them differently. This paper groups these responsibilities into nine modules, namely device connectivity and capability registration, perception and event extraction, home state, memory management, model serving, Agent orchestration, safe execution, cloud-edge collaboration, and feedback and auditing.
The interoperability of the device connectivity layer determines whether the architecture can scale. Research built on the Matter standard combines a unified device standard with large-model applications, so that devices from different vendors can be invoked by models through a single semantic interface; this dissertation provides a complete engineering case from device connectivity to application implementation, indicating that standardized connectivity and upper-layer model orchestration require co-design [6]. Research based on edge computing decomposes an intelligent control framework into a layered structure of perception and connectivity, edge processing, and cloud collaboration, and examines its role in response speed and resource allocation through practical cases, which helps in understanding how the nine modules can be layered and realized in engineering practice [7].
blocks.zh:
跨系统比较得分,第一,一种观察:家用本地服务器反复承担一套完全一样的责任;不同的系统只是命名和结合不同. 本文件将这些责任分为9个单元,即设备连接和能力登记、感知和事件提取、家庭状况、记忆管理、模型服务、代理管弦乐、安全执行、云端协作以及反馈和审计。
设备连接层的互操作性决定了架构是否能够规模化. 建立在Mater标准上的研究将一个统一的设备标准与大模型应用相结合,这样来自不同供应商的设备可以通过单一语义接口被模型引用;这一论文提供了一个从设备连接到应用执行的完整的工程案例,表明标准化的连接和上层模型管弦需要共同设计[6]. 基于边缘计算的研究将智能控制框架分解为感知和连通,边缘处理,云合作的分层结构,并通过实际案例来研究其在响应速度和资源配置中的作用,这有助于理解9个模块如何在工程实践中分层实现[7].

blocks.en: 3.2 The Organizational Logic among Modules
blocks.zh: 3.2 国家 模块之间的组织逻辑

blocks.en: How modules are organized matters more than the module list itself. Judging from the commonality of existing systems, one recommendable pipeline is as follows: natural-language and multimodal models handle perceptual interpretation, intent understanding, and candidate planning; home state, memory, and the device capability registry provide structured context to the models; the policy layer handles model routing, user confirmation, and permission judgment; deterministic verifiers, graph constraints, or authorization leases confine candidate actions to a verifiable execution space; finally, device adapters carry out the actions and write the results into audit records.
blocks.zh: 模块的组织事项比模块本身清单还要多. 从现有系统的共性来看,一个可推荐的管道如下:自然语言和多式联运模式处理概念解释、意向理解和候选人规划;家庭状况、内存和装置能力登记册为模型提供结构化的背景;政策层处理模型的路由、用户确认和许可判断;确定核查人、图表限制或授权租赁将候选人的行动限制在可核查的执行空间;最后,设备适配人采取行动并将结果写入审计记录。

blocks.en: Different systems arrange “local” in different ways, which can be roughly divided into three routes. The first route keeps models and profiles local. HomeLLaMA pairs a locally customized small model with a cloud-based teacher model, organizing local user profiles and device discovery into a privacy-preserving service path, with emphasis on the coordination between personalization and local profiles [8]. Harmony combines a locally deployable model with modular Agents and structured prompts, controlling hallucination and misinterpretation through module division of labor and prompt constraints [9]. The second route keeps state, orchestration, and authorization on edge nodes, while inference may be offloaded. HearthNet implements multi-Agent orchestration and Git-managed shared state on edge hardware, coordinating planning, verification, authorization, and execution through a message bus, execution leases, and timeline tracking; its inference stage uses hosted interfaces, taking the form of “orchestration and state local, inference offloadable” rather than that of a fully local system [10]. The third route embeds models directly into devices or IoT networks. Thoughtful Things places small language models into individual devices, completing interaction and interpretation locally [12]; Talk with the Things integrates language models into IoT networks, so that devices are invoked in a unified manner [13]. The three routes jointly indicate that the crux of local-first is not that all inference runs offline, but rather which state and control stages the home node holds.
blocks.zh: 不同的系统以不同的方式安排“局部”路线,大致可分为三条路线。 第一路线保持模型和剖面图本地化. HomeLLaMA将本地定制的小型模型与基于云的教师模型搭配,组织本地用户简介和设备发现进入隐私保存服务路径,强调个性化与本地简介之间的协调[8]. 和谐将当地可部署模式与模块化代理和结构化提示相结合,通过模块分工和即时约束控制幻觉和误解 [9]. 第二条路线在边缘节点上保持状态,管弦,和授权,而推论可能被卸载. HearthNet在边缘硬件上执行多代理管弦乐和Git管理共享状态,通过信息总线、执行租赁和时间表跟踪协调规划、核查、授权和执行;其推断阶段使用托管接口,其形式是“ordestation and state local, exposeable”而不是完全本地系统[10]。 第三条路线将模型直接嵌入设备或IOT网络. 思绪 事物将小语言模型放入单个设备中,完成本地交互和解释[12];与Thines的Talk将语言模型集成到IOT网络中,这样设备就能被统一引用[13]. 这三条路线共同表明,地方第一的症结并不是所有推论都离线,而是哪个状态和控制阶段是主节点的。

blocks.en: All three routes involve the boundary between generation and execution. The dissertation Speaking to the Edge installs deterministic gating between conversational control and physical execution, verifying model-generated control instructions before driving devices [11]. This gating mechanism can be combined with the three deployment routes described above; its function is to confine open-ended generation within a verifiable action space.
blocks.zh: 所有三条路线都涉及生成与执行之间的边界. 向Edge演讲的论文在对话控制与实际执行之间安装了决定性的格调,在驾驶设备前验证模型生成的控制指令[11]. 这种定位机制可与上述三条部署路线相结合;其功能是将无限制的一代限制在一个可核查的行动空间内。

blocks.en: Figure 1: Overall architecture of the home local server.
blocks.zh: 图 1:家用本地服务器的整体架构.

blocks.en: The actual coverage of individual systems varies, and no single paper proposes a complete nine-module architecture: some focus on models and profiles, some on orchestration and authorization, and some on single-device embedding. The significance of mapping them onto unified modules lies in identifying which responsibilities recur in home services, which stages already possess relatively mature engineering patterns, and which modules still lack reliable implementations. The nine modules simultaneously serve as the analytical language of the subsequent chapters: Section 4 focuses on state, memory, and model serving; Section 5 links orchestration and execution through the thread of applications; Section 6 concentrates on safe execution and cloud-edge collaboration.
blocks.zh: 单个系统的实际覆盖范围各有不同,没有一份论文提出完整的九单元架构:部分侧重于模型和剖面,部分侧重于管弦和授权,部分则用于单调嵌入. 将它们映射到统一模块的重要性在于确定哪些责任在家庭服务中重复出现,哪些阶段已经具备相对成熟的工程模式,哪些模块仍然缺乏可靠的实施。 这9个单元同时作为以下各章的分析语言: 第4节侧重于状态、内存和模式服务; 第5节通过应用程序链路将管弦和执行联系起来; 第6节侧重于安全执行和云端合作。

blocks.en: Home state must both provide context to models and constrain the action space; memory management needs to cover writing, maintenance, retrieval, and deletion; and model orchestration allocates capabilities according to call sites. Together, these three determine whether a home local server can remain controllable under continuous operation.
blocks.zh: 母体状态必须既为模型提供上下文,又限制动作空间;内存管理需要涵盖写作,维护,检索和删除;模型管弦按调用站点分配能力. 这三者共同决定一个家用本地服务器能否在连续操作下保持可控性.

blocks.en: 4 Home State, Memory, and Model Orchestration
blocks.zh: 4 母国、记忆和模范管弦乐团

blocks.en: 4.1 Organization of Home State
blocks.zh: 4.1 母国组织

blocks.en: Home state provides the factual basis for all upper-layer functions and consists of the device registry, room topology, current device states, user preferences, and daily patterns. It is not merely a context for models to read; it is also a constraint that limits the action space. Trail constrains the candidate space with a runtime registry, replacing open-ended generation with typed decisions oriented toward rooms, devices, and operations, and employs a confidence mechanism to decline uncertain instructions rather than forcibly executing them [ 18 ] . This design clearly shows that the registry is, first and foremost, a structural constraint on the model’s output space and only secondarily an inventory of devices.
blocks.zh: 家用状态为所有上层功能提供事实依据,由设备注册,房间地形,当前设备状态,用户偏好,以及日常模式组成. 它不仅仅是模型阅读的背景;它也是限制行动空间的一个制约因素。 拖车以运行时间登记册限制候选人的空间,用针对房间、装置和操作的打字决定取代不限成员名额的一代,并使用一种信任机制来拒绝不确定的指示,而不是强行执行指示[18]。 这种设计清楚地表明,登记册首先是对模型输出空间的结构性限制,其次是设备清单。

blocks.en: The representation of preferences and daily patterns determines whether the system can handle personalized instructions. AdaHome dynamically selects between a simple path and a reasoning path through intent-aware routing, and updates preferences via user feedback without retraining or prompt expansion; it supports a design judgment: routing and preference adaptation matter more than choosing a single strongest model [ 16 ] . Related studies also show that context organization combining the home environment with user history can improve response relevance, but the effect depends on the degree of structuring of the context rather than its simple accumulation [ 21 ] .
blocks.zh: 偏好和日常模式的体现决定着系统能否处理个性化指令. AdaHome通过意向意识的路由在简单路径和推理路径之间动态选择,并通过用户反馈更新首选,而不进行再培训或迅速扩展;它支持设计判断:路线和偏好适应比选择单一最强模型更重要[16]. 相关研究还表明,将家庭环境与用户历史相结合的背景组织可以提高响应的相关性,但效果取决于背景的结构程度而不是简单的积累[21].

blocks.en: 4.2 Layering and Maintenance of Memory Management
blocks.zh: 4.2 内存管理的分层和维护

blocks.en: Short-term context and long-term memory require layered organization. The former serves multi-turn dialogue and the resolution of elliptical expressions; the latter includes user profiles, event experiences, and preference evolution. PEC-Home, targeting progressive elliptical instructions, separately examines the roles of dialogue history tools and environment and preference context, finding that retrieving dialogue history alone is insufficient to correctly resolve elliptical expressions and that environmental state and user preferences are equally indispensable [ 25 ] .
blocks.zh: 短期背景和长期记忆需要分层组织. 前者服务于多回合对话和椭圆表达式的解析;后者包括用户简介,事件经验和偏好演化. PEC-Home针对进步椭圆指示,分别考察对话历史工具的作用以及环境和偏好背景,发现仅检索对话历史不足以正确解决椭圆表达,环境状态和用户偏好同样是不可或缺的[25].

blocks.en: Long-term memory should be understood through a lifecycle of “writing, maintenance, retrieval, and deletion or governance,” rather than through retrieval alone. Embedded AI Companion distinguishes active and idle periods on edge devices: retrieval supports real-time dialogue during active periods, while more costly memory extraction, consolidation, and maintenance are performed during idle periods, explicitly framing memory scheduling as a server-level resource and latency design problem [ 4 ] . Mnemosyne stores long-term memory in a graph structure, accompanied by lifecycle operations such as write filtering, deduplication, commit and pruning, and temporal decay and refresh, and evaluates maintenance mechanisms beyond retrieval on longitudinal dialogue and temporal reasoning benchmarks [ 7 ] . Different households differ in write frequency, storage budget, and privacy constraints; no single memory architecture can serve as a universal solution, and memory strategies must be matched to local resource conditions.
blocks.zh: 长期记忆应当通过“写作、维护、检索和删除或治理”的生命周期来理解,而不是仅仅通过检索来理解。 嵌入式AI Companion区分了边缘设备上的活跃期和闲置期:检索支持在活跃期进行实时对话,而在闲置期进行成本更高的内存提取,整合和维护,明确将内存调度设定为服务器级资源,以及耐久性设计问题[4]. Mnemosyne将长期内存存储在一个图表结构中,同时进行生命周期操作,如书写过滤,调试,承诺和穿透,以及时间衰变和刷新,并在纵向对话和时间推理基准上评价超出检索范围的维护机制[7]. 不同的家庭在书写频率,存储预算和隐私限制上有所不同;任何单一的内存架构都不能作为通用解决方案,内存策略必须与本地资源条件相匹配.

blocks.en: The evaluation of retrieval augmentation must be bounded within specific experimental settings. The observation that “retrieving dialogue history alone is insufficient for resolution” indicates that vector retrieval cannot replace environmental state and preference modeling; however, this conclusion applies only to the tasks and tool configurations of that benchmark and cannot be generalized to the ineffectiveness of retrieval-augmented methods in general. The design of a memory system must therefore answer three interrelated questions: what content is worth writing, how to deduplicate and prune after writing, and how to combine temporal and situational information at retrieval. If any link is missing, memory can be “stored but not well used.”
blocks.zh: 对检索增强的评价必须在具体的实验环境中进行。 “仅仅检索对话历史不足以解决问题”的意见表明,矢量检索不能取代环境状态和偏好模型;然而,这一结论只适用于该基准的任务和工具配置,不能泛指一般检索方法无效。 因此,记忆系统的设计必须回答三个相互关联的问题:哪些内容值得写作,如何在写作后复制和prune,以及如何在检索时结合时间和情况信息。 如果缺少任何链接,记忆可以“储存,但没有得到很好的利用。 “

blocks.en: 4.3 Model Orchestration
blocks.zh: 4.3 示范管弦乐团

blocks.en: Model orchestration organizes model families by responsibility rather than by model size. What a system needs to determine is which capability to invoke under which circumstances: when to read memory, when to enable multimodal perception, when to require human confirmation, and when to trigger cloud fallback. Not Every Call Needs a Frontier Model evaluates the suitability of small models at each call site and finds that small models suffice at some call sites while stronger capabilities are required at others, providing empirical grounds for allocating models by call site [ 9 ] .
blocks.zh: 模范管弦乐根据责任而不是模型大小来组织模范家庭. 一个系统需要确定的是,在何种情况下可以援引哪些能力:何时读取记忆,何时使多式联运感知成为可能,何时需要人类确认,何时触发云回落。 并非每个呼叫需要一个前沿模型评价每个呼叫站点的小模型是否合适,发现一些呼叫站点小模型就足够了,而另一些则需要更强的能力,为按呼叫站点分配模型提供了经验依据[9].

blocks.en: Collaborative inference and training mechanisms further expand the orchestration space. A survey of collaborative inference between small edge models and large cloud models classifies existing algorithms by execution mode and division of labor, showing that local and remote models can collaborate in segments within the same task pipeline [ 14 ] . On the training side, Edge-FIT performs instruction fine-tuning of quantized models in a federated manner, enabling home environment data to participate in model adaptation without being centrally exported [ 28 ] . Orchestration is therefore not a one-time model selection but a continuous decision encompassing inference division of labor, training adaptation, and fallback governance.
blocks.zh: 合作推论和培训机制进一步扩大了组织空间。 对小边缘模型和大云模型之间合作推论的调查,将现有的算法按照执行模式和分工进行分类,显示本地模型和远程模型可以在相同任务管道内的段进行协作[14]. 在培训方面,Edge-FIT以联合方式进行量化模型的精细调整,使家庭环境数据能够参与模型改造,而无需集中输出[28]. 因此,管弦乐不是一次性模式选择,而是包括劳动分工、培训适应和倒置治理在内的持续决定。

blocks.en: 5 Home Applications: Home Control, Emotional Companionship, and Intelligent Guarding
blocks.zh: 5 家用应用:家用控制,情感伴奏,以及智能卫视

blocks.en: Home control, emotional companionship, and intelligent guarding share home state and memory, but differ in their requirements for module composition, evidence types, and risk boundaries. Comparing these three application categories tests whether a unified architecture suffices to cover divergent task demands.
blocks.zh: 家庭控制,情感伴侣关系,以及智能守护共享家庭状态和记忆,但在模块组成,证据类型和风险界限方面的要求不同. 比较这三种应用类别,可以测试统一架构是否足以满足不同的任务需求.

blocks.en: 5.1 Home Control and Natural Human-Computer Interaction
blocks.zh: 5.1 家庭控制和自然人类-计算机相互作用

blocks.en: The evolution of home control capabilities exhibits a clear progression: from explicit single-device commands, to multi-device coordination, and then to vague and elliptical expressions, preference dependence, persistent rules, and failure recovery with safe refusals. Early work established the basic paradigm of goal inference and grounded execution. Sasha targets creative goal-directed reasoning, decomposing vague goals into executable home tasks [ 12 ] ; SAGE employs a grounded execution mechanism to ensure that device actions invoked by the Agent correspond to real capabilities [ 22 ] .
blocks.zh: 家用控制能力的演变显示出明显的进步:从明确的单声道指令,到多声道协调,再到模糊和椭圆的表达,偏好依赖,持续的规则,以及安全拒绝的故障恢复. 早期的工作确立了目标推论和有根据的执行的基本范式. Sasha针对创造性的目标导向推理,将模糊的目标分解为可执行的家庭任务[12];SAGE使用一个有根据的执行机制,以确保代理商引用的设备动作符合实际能力[22].

blocks.en: On resource-constrained local hardware, there is direct experimental evidence on whether a single model can undertake both understanding and generation. On-Device LLMs for Home Assistant assigns a single model both intent slot detection and response generation, outputting JSON action calls and natural language. Evaluation shows that the 16-bit and 8-bit quantized versions maintain high accuracy, while the 4-bit version degrades noticeably on device service classification; accuracy on noisy and out-of-domain instructions is approximately 80–86%, with an average inference latency of 5–6 seconds, suitable for one-shot commands but unfavorable for multi-turn dialogue [ 1 ] . These results simultaneously demonstrate the feasibility of the local control interface and the trade-off between latency and quantization.
blocks.zh: 关于受资源限制的当地硬件,有直接的实验证据表明,单一模型是否能够既理解又生成。 On-Device LLMs for Home Assistants 分配一个单一的模型,既包括意向槽检测,也包括响应生成,输出JSON动作呼叫和自然语言. 评价显示,16位和8位的量化版本保持高精度,而4位版本在设备服务分类上明显降解;在吵闹和域外指令上的精度约为80–86 %,平均推断空档为5–6秒,适合一发命令,但不适合多回合对话[1]. 这些结果同时证明了局部控制接口的可行性以及暂时性和量化之间的权衡.

blocks.en: Control performance depends on the combination of the model with the device registry, home state, memory, and a deterministic validator, rather than on the model alone. The model handles understanding and candidate planning; the executor confines actual actions to the legal space. HomeBench supports this judgment from the opposite direction: by testing 13 models with valid and invalid commands and single-device and multi-device tasks, it finds that invalid multi-device commands are a pervasive failure hotspot, and that architecture must treat validity checking and multi-device execution verification as first-class responsibilities [ 15 ] .
blocks.zh: 控制性能取决于模型与设备注册,家用状态,内存,以及确定性验证器的结合,而不是单靠模型. 该模型处理理解和候选人规划;执行者将实际行动限于法律空间。 HomeBench从相反的方向支持这个判断:通过测试13种具有有效且无效的命令和单设备及多设备任务的模式,它发现无效的多设备命令是普遍存在的故障热点,而架构必须将有效性检查和多设备执行验证视为一流的责任[15].

blocks.en: Chinese industrial practice reveals the direction of evolution for interaction entry points. Research on smart-speaker voice interaction proposes a technical path combining a full-duplex dialogue engine, role-playing agents, and voice cloning, shifting speakers from single-turn command responses toward interruptible, continuous natural dialogue, and connecting external knowledge and device control through tool-invocation mechanisms [ 33 ] . Interaction upgrades at entry devices must be matched by orchestration and execution capabilities on the home server side; improving the dialogue experience at the entry point alone cannot guarantee that physical actions are reliably carried out.
blocks.zh: 中国产业实践揭示互动切入点进化方向. 智能语音交互研究提出一个技术路径,将全复式对话引擎,角色扮演代理和语音克隆结合起来,将演讲者从单回合指令响应转向中断,连续的自然对话,并通过工具调用机制连接外部知识和设备控制[33]. 入口设备的交互升级必须与主服务器一侧的管弦和执行能力相匹配;仅改进入口点的对话经验无法保证物理动作得到可靠执行.

blocks.en: 5.2 Emotional Companionship: Local Memory and Sustained Relationships
blocks.zh: 5.2 情感伴侣关系:地方记忆与持久关系

blocks.en: Emotional companionship relies on four elements: local persona, long-term memory, proactive interaction, and emotional safety. Systematic research on persona design organizes the personas of companionship applications into a four-quadrant technical taxonomy, providing a structured language for persona selection across scenarios [ 26 ] . The aforementioned dual-phase maintenance of active and idle periods and the graph-structured memory architecture enable companionship systems to maintain longitudinal continuity under resource constraints [ 3 ] .
blocks.zh: 情感伴侣关系依赖于四个要素:局部人物a,长期记忆,主动互动,以及情感安全. 关于人的设计的系统研究将同伴应用的人格组织为四夸度技术分类法,为跨情景的人物选择提供结构化语言[26]. 上述活动期和闲置期的双阶段维护以及图式结构的内存架构,使得同伴系统能够在资源限制下保持纵向连续性[3].

blocks.en: Identity recognition and privacy boundaries in multi-member households are unavoidable. e-VITA implements speaker diarization and spoken dialogue on the device, allowing the conversations and profiles of different members to be distinguished and processed locally [ 20 ] . Research on empathetic robot design for elderly users summarizes expression and interaction strategies in age-friendly scenarios, emphasizing that persona settings must match user characteristics [ 5 ] .
blocks.zh: 多成员家庭中的身份识别和隐私界限是不可避免的。 e-VITA执行对讲机的对称化和对设备的语音对话,使不同成员的对话和简介能够在当地区分和处理[20]。 针对老年用户的情感机器人设计研究总结了对老年人友好的情景中的表达和互动策略,强调人物设置必须符合用户特征[5].

blocks.en: Proactive interaction is the key capability that distinguishes companionship from passive response, and it is also the most prone to overstepping. Local profiles and memory enable the system to initiate reminders or conversations at appropriate moments; however, if the frequency of proactivity, the range of topics, and quiet hours lack user-controllable policies, continuous care becomes persistent disturbance. Trigger rules should be made explicit and allow users to adjust or even disable them by scenario, consistent with the overall approach of tiered permissions.
blocks.zh: 主动互动是区分伴奏和被动反应的关键能力,也是最容易超越的能力. 本地概况和内存使系统能够在适当的时候启动提醒或对话;但是,如果主动性的频率、专题范围以及安静的小时缺乏用户可控制的政策,持续的注意就成为持续的干扰。 触发规则应当明确,允许用户按照分层权限的总体方法,按情景调整甚至禁用.

blocks.en: Maintaining continuous dialogue and personalized responses at the technical level does not mean that effectiveness at the social level has been established. This paper does not describe companionship systems as means to “improve mental health” or “alleviate loneliness”; the relevant longitudinal psychological effects require support from independent human-computer interaction research designs. A systematic review of mental health scenarios shows that model applications in this field remain at the stage of pattern exploration, with limited evidential strength [ 19 ] . Research on local-first psychological counseling architectures proposes the judgment that “the model is not the product,” emphasizing that deterministic pillars and generative pillars require side-by-side design [ 2 ] .
blocks.zh: 在技术一级保持持续的对话和个性化的对策并不意味着在社会一级建立了效力。 本文没有将陪伴系统描述为“改善精神健康”或“减轻孤独”的手段;相关的纵向心理影响需要独立的人计算机交互研究设计的支持。 对心理健康情景的系统审查表明,这一领域的模型应用仍处于模式探索阶段,证据力有限[19]。 对当地第一心理咨询架构的研究提出了“模型不是产品”的判断,强调确定性支柱和基因支柱需要边设计[2]。

blocks.en: 5.3 Intelligent Guarding: From Perceptual Triage to Risk Escalation
blocks.zh: 5.3 智能卫士:从概念性绊脚石到风险升级

blocks.en: The pipeline of intelligent guarding can be summarized as: perceptual input, local event recognition, integration of state and behavioral history, anomaly judgment, and risk grading, followed by escalation to personal reminders, family notifications, human care, or emergency services. Perception and event extraction research first addresses “what has been detected.” DESAMO processes raw audio directly with an embedded audio model, resolving ordinary control intents and critical events such as falls and calls for help uniformly at the same node, avoiding error accumulation caused by multi-level speech recognition cascades [ 27 ] . Such single-node schemes shorten the recognition chain, but their evidential scope remains limited to established sensing modalities and event categories and cannot independently demonstrate that the system can continuously detect deviations in household behavioral patterns.
blocks.zh: 智能守护的管道可以概括为:知觉输入,局部事件识别,状态与行为历史的融合,异常判断,以及风险分级,然后升级为个人提醒,家庭通知,人文关怀,或紧急服务. 认知和事件提取研究首先涉及“检测到的”。 DESAMO直接用嵌入式音频模型处理原始音频,解决普通控制意图和坠落等关键事件,并呼吁在同一节点统一帮助,避免多层次语音识别级联导致的错误积累[27]. 这种单节点方案缩短了识别链,但其证据范围仍然局限于既定的感知方式和事件类别,无法独立地表明系统能够持续检测家庭行为模式的偏差.

blocks.en: Environmental sensor and multimodal studies supplement the event context. Sensor events are first transformed into activity sequences, which are then interpreted by a language model in context, providing a prototypical path for complex activity tracking and behavioral pattern analysis [ 8 ] . OmniSmartHome incorporates speaker identity, spatial location, and audio-visual cues into a multimodal evaluation, whose baseline Agent coordinates the various perceptual tools with procedural memory [ 10 ] . The former demonstrates a system implementation approach, while the latter provides a tool for comparing model reasoning capabilities; the evidence of both concentrates mainly on recognition and reasoning performance and cannot as yet substitute for long-term deployment testing in real homes.
blocks.zh: 环境传感器和多式联运研究是对事件背景的补充。 传感器事件首先转化为活动序列,然后在上下文中被语言模型解释,为复杂的活动跟踪和行为模式分析提供了原型路径[8]. 预告 本国将演讲者身份、空间位置和视听提示纳入多式联运评价,其基线 代理协调各种感知工具与程序内存[10]. 前者展示了一种系统实施方法,后者则为比较模型推理能力提供了工具;两者的证据主要集中于识别和推理性能,目前还不能取代在真实家庭的长期部署测试.

blocks.en: Demand-side and service research addresses “how to act after recognition.” Research on agents for elder-care scenarios surveys the opportunities and challenges of care tasks, providing scenario grounds for risk grading and human handover [ 6 ] . Research on community-based home care service systems discusses platform combinations of safety protection, personalized diet, and companionship [ 30 ] ; a voice assistant for elderly companionship implements dialogue and reminders locally [ 17 ] . These studies provide demand and functional evidence rather than recognition accuracy evidence. Synthesizing the three categories of material, a guarding system needs to connect perceptual triage, contextual interpretation, and human escalation into a chain; event recognition constitutes only a risk indication, not a substitute for medical diagnosis or professional care, and prototype results cannot be extrapolated as long-term effects in real homes.
blocks.zh: 需求方和服务研究涉及“承认后如何行动”。 对老年人护理情景代理人的研究调查了护理任务的机会和挑战,为风险评级和人员移交提供了情景依据[6]。 关于基于社区的家庭护理服务系统的研究讨论了安全保护、个性化饮食和陪护等平台组合;一位老年陪护的语音助理在当地开展对话和提醒[17]。 这些研究提供了需求证据和功能证据,而不是识别准确性证据. 综合三类材料,护卫系统需要将知觉分解,背景解释,人文升级连为一条链条;事件识别仅构成风险指示,不能替代医疗诊断或专业护理,原型结果不能作为真实家庭的长期影响推算.

blocks.en: 5.4 Cross-Application Comparison
blocks.zh: 5.4 交叉应用比较

blocks.en: The three application categories share home state, memory, registry constraints, and audit records, but impose different parameter requirements on the same set of modules. Home control is latency-sensitive and requires understanding, verification, and execution to be tightly coupled; its failures manifest primarily as erroneous execution. Emotional companionship imposes higher demands on proactivity and persona consistency, with risks lying in intrusive overreach and privacy confusion. Intelligent guarding must balance false alarms against missed detections simultaneously, impose stricter constraints on missed detections and escalation latency, and retain a human escalation path, so that triage conclusions do not directly become final judgments. The role of the unified architecture is to let shared modules adjust their configurations by task, not to equate the requirements of the three application categories.
blocks.zh: 三种应用类别共享主机状态,内存,注册限制,以及审计记录,但对同一套模块规定了不同的参数要求. 家庭控制对长期性具有敏感性,需要理解、核查和执行紧密结合;其失败主要表现为错误执行。 情感伴侣关系对主动性和人性一致性提出了更高的要求,其中存在侵入性过度接触和隐私混乱的风险。 智能卫视必须同时平衡假警报和失检,对失检和升级延迟施加更严格的限制,并保留人气升级路径,以免分辨结论直接成为最终判断. 统一架构的作用是让共享模块按任务调整其配置,而不是等同三个应用类别的要求.

blocks.en: 6 Security, Privacy, and Cloud-Edge Collaboration
blocks.zh: 6 安全、隐私和云端协作

blocks.en: The safety constraints on home actions can be distinguished by point of action into pre-execution, in-execution, and post-execution. Local deployment does not inherently confer safety; local systems may likewise suffer from configuration errors, permission abuse, and tool-chain attacks. Safety depends on concrete mechanisms rather than on deployment location itself.
blocks.zh: 家庭行动的安全限制可以通过行动点区分为执行前,执行中,执行后. 当地部署本身并不赋予安全;当地系统同样可能遭受配置错误、滥用许可和工具链攻击。 安全取决于具体机制,而不是部署地点本身。

blocks.en: 6.1 Local-by-Default and Tiered Authorization
blocks.zh: 6.1 逐个地方过失和分级授权

blocks.en: The risks of home actions are not uniform, and permission design should reflect a gradient. From low to high risk, actions can be divided into ordinary queries, routine controls such as lighting and air conditioning, camera analysis, door lock operations, and high-risk alerts. Low-risk actions can be executed automatically on-premises; the closer an operation is to physical safety and privacy sensitivity, the stronger the confirmation and authorization required. The execution lease mechanism of HearthNet embodies this approach: the Agent may drive execution only upon obtaining a time-limited authorization, and expired or unauthorized commands are rejected [ 32 ] .
blocks.zh: 家庭行动的风险并不统一,许可设计应反映梯度。 从低风险到高风险,动作可以分为普通查询,照明和空调等常规控制,相机分析,门锁操作,以及高风险警报. 低风险动作可以在前提上自动执行;操作越接近人身安全和隐私敏感性,所需的确认和授权就越强. HearthNet的执行租赁机制体现了这种方法:代理只有在获得时限授权后才能推动执行,过期或未经授权的命令被拒绝[32].

blocks.en: 6.2 Structured Safety Mechanisms
blocks.zh: 6.2 结构化安全机制

blocks.en: Pre-execution constraints first address rule conflicts. SHACR represents devices, capabilities, states, and topology as a typed knowledge graph, confines the large model’s interpretations and repair suggestions within the graph boundaries, and completes validation before execution through a closed loop of “scan, explain, repair, and verify.” Its testing covers 203 rules and 70 apartment configurations, providing experimental evidence for semi-autonomous conflict resolution under graph constraints [ 31 ] .
blocks.zh: 执行前的限制首先涉及规则冲突。 SHACR 将设备、能力、状态和地形作为打字的知识图,将大模型的解释和修复建议限制在图界内,并通过封闭的“扫描、解释、修复和核实”循环,完成执行前的验证。 其测试涵盖203条规则和70套公寓配置,为在图表限制下半自主冲突解决提供了实验证据[31].

blocks.en: Post-execution monitoring and auditing primarily target the tool chain. AegisMCP records behaviors among Agents, tools, devices, remote services, and sessions as temporal graphs, performs online anomaly detection on streaming events, and can identify patterns such as privilege escalation, data exfiltration, malicious registration, and persistence; detection completes at sub-second latency and is suitable for CPU edge hardware [ 29 ] . System-level attack surface research further points out that the security risks of edge Agent deployment are distributed across the tool, session, and device layers, and that the provenance and permissions of the tool chain should themselves be treated as observable security state [ 11 ] . Beyond the execution chain, configuration maintenance is also indispensable. SmartHomeSecure performs syntactic and common semantic error detection on Home Assistant YAML configuration files and completes automated repair through deterministic repair and constrained generation, complementing efforts to reduce automation failures caused by configuration errors [ 23 ] .
blocks.zh: 执行后监测和审计主要针对工具链。 AegisMCP将代理商,工具,设备,远程服务和会话之间的行为记录为时间图,在流媒体事件上进行在线异常检测,并可识别特权升级,数据过滤,恶意注册,持久性等模式;检测完成于次秒潜伏,适合CPU边缘硬件[29]. 系统级攻击表面研究进一步指出,边缘物剂部署的安全风险分布在工具,会话,设备层中,工具链的出处和权限本身应作为可观察到的安全状态处理[11]. 在执行链之外,配置维护也是不可或缺的. SmartHomeSecure在家庭助理YAML配置文件中进行协同和常见的语义错误检测,并通过定点修复和限制生成完成自动化修复,补充减少配置错误造成的自动化故障的努力[23].

blocks.zh: 图 2:安全执行环节:从事件到鉴定,执行,以及提醒.

blocks.en: 6.3 Privacy and Auditable Cloud Fallback
blocks.zh: 6.3 隐私和可审计云退

blocks.en: A security survey of language models in IoT ecosystems shows that threat types span the data, model, and application layers, and that deployment location cannot substitute for mechanism design [ 24 ] . In designs that retain cloud fallback, auditability is central to privacy governance. Every remote call should record the triggering reason, the fields transmitted, the service used, the returned result, whether execution occurred, and the user’s confirmation status, rendering fallback behavior visible and traceable to the user.
blocks.zh: 对IOT生态系统语言模型的安全调查表明,威胁类型跨越数据、模型和应用层,部署地点不能取代机制设计[24]。 在保留云回落的设计中,可审计性是隐私治理的核心. 每一个远程调用都应该记录触发原因,传输的字段,使用的服务,返回的结果,是否执行,以及用户的确认状态,使回落行为可以被看到并可追踪到用户.

blocks.en: Platform-side practice offers a reference. Home Assistant describes, in its official updates, designs including selectable local and cloud models, the exclusion of generative models from critical tasks, and per-device model assignment [ 13 ] . These materials are used solely to describe platform functionality and do not constitute peer-reviewed conclusions regarding security.
blocks.zh: 平台侧做法提供了一个参考。 家庭助理在其正式更新中描述了设计,包括可选择的局部模型和云模型,将基因模型排除在关键任务之外,以及每个设备模型的任务[13]. 这些材料仅用于描述平台功能,不构成同行审议的安全结论。

blocks.en: 7 Unified Evaluation Framework, Design Principles, and Future Agenda
blocks.zh: 7 统一评价框架、设计原则和未来议程

blocks.en: 7.1 Positioning and Limitations of Existing Benchmarks
blocks.zh: 7.1 现有基准的位置和局限性

blocks.en: Existing benchmarks respectively examine instruction validity, context resolution, multimodal reasoning, and cross-device execution, covering different facets of architectural capability. HomeBench focuses on valid and invalid command handling [ 15 ] , and PEC-Home focuses on elliptical expressions and their dependence on context and preferences [ 25 ] ; the two indicate that validity checking, home state, and preference context should enter basic capability evaluations. OmniSmartHome examines multimodal reasoning with 1,360 synthetic event clips and 272 real event clips [ 8 ] , while DevicesWorld targets cross-device Agent evaluation in heterogeneous environments [ 13 ] ; the two broaden perceptual cues and device environments, but do not yet cover long-term memory maintenance, permission escalation, and cloud fallback auditing.
blocks.zh: 现有基准分别审查指令的有效性、上下文解析、多式联运推理和跨设备执行,涵盖建筑能力的不同方面。 HomeBench专注于有效和无效的命令处理[15],而PEC-Home则侧重于椭圆表达以及其对上下文和偏好依赖[25];两者表示有效性检查,主状态,偏好上下文应当输入基本能力评价. OmniSmartHome以1,360个合成事件剪辑和272个真实事件剪辑来审查多式联运推理[8],而DublesWorld则针对不同环境下的交叉设备代理评价[13];两个拓宽的透视提示和设备环境,但尚未涵盖长期内存维护,许可升级,以及云回落审计.

blocks.en: 7.2 Design Principles
blocks.zh: 7.2 设计原则

blocks.en: The evidence presented above can be compressed into six design principles. First, separate generation from execution: models produce candidates, while deterministic modules handle verification and execution. Second, state precedes intelligence: constrain the model’s output space with the registry, topology, and state. Third, layer memory and maintain its lifecycle: configure write filtering, pruning, and temporal policies. Fourth, orchestrate models by responsibility: allocate capabilities by call site and retain auditable cloud fallback. Fifth, tier permissions by risk: the closer an action is to physical safety and sensitive data, the stronger the confirmation required. Sixth, ensure end-to-end auditability: record key events, remote invocations, and human confirmations to support post-hoc traceability.
blocks.zh: 上述证据可压缩为六项设计原则. 第一,从执行中分离生成:模型产生候选人,而决定性模块处理核查和执行. 第二,状态先于智能:用注册、地形和状态限制模型的输出空间。 第三,层内存并维持其生命周期:配置书写过滤,穿透,以及时间政策. 第四,按责任来协调模型:按呼叫地点分配能力,保留可审计云回落。 第五,按风险分级许可:行动越接近于人身安全和敏感数据,所需确认就越强。 第六,确保端到端的可审计性:记录关键事件,远程引用,以及人性确认以支持后热追溯.

blocks.en: 7.3 Future Research Agenda
blocks.zh: 7.3 未来的研究议程

blocks.en: The future research agenda corresponds item by item to the gaps identified above. Regarding the disconnect between simulated environments and real deployments, behavioral drift caused by model updates lacks mature governance mechanisms, requiring version management and regression testing methods oriented toward home scenarios. Regarding cloud fallback and data minimization, operational rules need to be established between functional availability and data minimization. Regarding memory accumulation and deletion governance, the memory store itself may become a concentration point for sensitive data, requiring dedicated design for encryption, access control, and deletion mechanisms. Regarding the lack of unified standards for age-friendly evaluation, existing evidence largely comes from prototypes and small-scale settings, and more real-environment studies are needed. The balance between privacy and usability in multimodal perception, and the practical feasibility of federated and collaborative training under home bandwidth conditions, also await further experimentation.
blocks.zh: 未来的研究议程逐项对应上述差距。 关于模拟环境和实际部署之间的脱节,模型更新引起的行为漂移缺乏成熟的治理机制,需要面向家庭情景的版本管理和回归测试方法。 关于云回落和尽量减少数据,需要在功能可得性和尽量减少数据之间制定操作规则。 关于内存积累和删除治理,内存存储本身可能成为敏感数据的集中点,需要专门设计加密,访问控制和删除机制. 关于缺乏对老年人友好的评价的统一标准,现有证据主要来自原型和小规模环境,需要更多的实际环境研究。 在多式联运概念中,隐私和可用性之间的平衡,以及在家庭带宽条件下进行联合和协作培训的实际可行性,也有待进一步试验。

blocks.en: 7.4 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7.4 结论

blocks.en: Using the home local server as an organizing axis, this paper synthesizes nine modules into a unified analytical framework and surveys the evidence across three application categories on this basis. The central judgment is this: the key to local-first intelligent homes does not lie in shrinking a cloud-based large model and deploying it on a home server, but in organizing state, memory, model routing, permission policies, and deterministic execution so that home intelligence becomes a continuously running, auditable, and layered-governance computing system. What this paper offers is an architectural framework and design possibilities, not a finished system validated in real homes. Local deployment is not inherently safer, and the social and medical effects of companionship and guarding do not automatically follow from technical continuity. The value of subsequent research will be tested through the completion of real-deployment evidence and governance mechanisms.
blocks.zh: 本文以家用本地服务器为组织轴,将9个模块合成一个统一的分析框架,并在此基础上调查三个应用类别的证据. 中央判断是这样的:本地第一智能家庭的关键不在于缩小一个基于云的大型模型并将其部署在家庭服务器上,而在于组织状态,内存,模式路由,许可政策,以及决定性的处决,以便家庭智能成为一个持续运行,可审计,分层治理的计算系统. 本文提供的是一个建筑框架和设计可能性,而不是一个在真正的家庭中验证的完成系统. 当地部署本质上并不更加安全,陪伴和守卫的社会和医疗影响不会自动从技术连续性中产生。 将通过完成实际部署的证据和治理机制来检验随后的研究的价值。
